The '''Flitter Suit''' was a model of tech [[Environment suit/Legends|vacuum suit]] manufactured by [[Regallis Engineering/Legends|Regallis Engineering]]. The Flitter Suit had durable fabric to protect from rips and tears and an inbuilt [[Rocket pack/Legends|rocket pack]] for maneuvering in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The rocket pack was controlled from a wrist mount panel and had enough [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] for only a few bursts.<ref name="PSG" />
